## About
EU Auto Group is on Quincey Street, near uptown Charlotte. We offer service and repair for European and Japanese vehicles, including Mercedes, BMW, Lexus, Infiniti, Acura and high-end exotics. We serve drivers in Charlotte, Mint Hill and Matthews.
Our philosophy is one of total customer care. That covers everything from towing and vehicle pickup to customer drop-off, so the experience stays affordable and comfortable.
Reviewers mention Paul and Ethan by name, and we are rated 4.9 from 109 Google reviews.

## Services
- Routine maintenance and service: Regular care for your Mercedes, BMW, Lexus or other import.
- Manufacturer-recommended interval service: Service performed on the schedule your vehicle's maker recommends.
- Major engine, transmission and drivetrain repairs: Repair work on engines, transmissions and drivetrains.
- Cosmetic and major paint and body work including ding repair: From small dings to major body and paint work.
- Towing and vehicle pick-up: We can bring your vehicle to the shop.
- Customer drop-off and pick-up: We can take you where you need to go while we work on your car.

## FAQ
Q: Which vehicles do you work on?
A: We service European and Japanese vehicles, including Mercedes, BMW, Lexus, Infiniti, Acura and high-end exotics. Our site also lists Aston Martin and Jaguar.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes. We offer towing and vehicle pick-up, as well as customer drop-off and pick-up.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Call us at 980-322-8009 or email service@euautogroup.com to set up an appointment or discuss your vehicle.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.
